justification: Re-derived by hand: Kalshi floor 66199.99 plus one cent equals the Polymarket floor 66200 exactly, both legs exclusive, both listed closes 13:00Z to the millisecond (close_delta_ms 0), entity Bitcoin on both sides. The captured rules text supports both functional fields verbatim: Polymarket reads the "Close" price of the BTC/USDT 1 hour candle "that ends on the time and date specified in the title", Kalshi the "simple average of the sixty seconds ... before" the same hour, so point-close against 60s window-mean is faithful. All three caveats are present and accurate. Reservation recorded but not scored against the row: after the artifact's own cent-bridge the thresholds read inclusive-66200 against exclusive-66200, which the bound fields ("exclusive"/"exclusive") conceal.
